title: The other four clan capitals
changes: Four more clan capitals open their gates: Duskveil of the Veiled Circle beside the Veiled Sanctum, Marrowkeep of the Ossuary Host beside the Host's Muster, Scarwall of the Redfang Compact beside Fangrock, and Deepden of the Hide-Kin beside Hidehall.

Each has its own leader who pays rank rewards and names Bannerets with a clan title, an oath-keeper to swear to and bind home with, a drillmaster, a stash, a waystone and a quartermaster selling the land's own armour and flasks, 10 percent less for the sworn.
Heroes from Lv 5 can pass a city gate. Clans at war with the city, and heroes it has Wanted, stay outside.
